arxiv-2112-12330.creator: Thomas A. Trainor
arxiv-2112-12330.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Thomas A. Trainor. This is the second part of a two-part article on precision modeling of identified-hadron (PID) p t p_{t} spectra from 5 TeV p p -Pb collisions. pmc-11803449.title: CSE-8, a filamentous fungus-specific Shr3-like chaperone, facilitates endoplasmic reticulum exit of chitin synthase CHS-3 (class I) in Neurospora crassa
pmc-11803449.creator: Samantha Verónica González-Téllez, Meritxell Riquelme
pmc-11803449.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Chitin is a crucial structural polysaccharide in fungal cell walls, essential for maintaining cellular plasticity and integrity. Its synthesis is orchestrated by chitin synthases (CHS), a major family of transmembrane proteins. In Saccharomyces cerevisiae, the cargo receptor Chs7, belonging to the Shr3-like chaperone family, plays a pivotal role in the exit of Chs3 from the endoplasmic reticulum (ER) and its subsequent activity in the plasma membrane (PM). However, the auxiliary machinery responsible for CHS trafficking in filamentous fungi remains poorly understood.
